description: The remainder with a negative divisor and a positive dividend is positive
notes: The spec calls % the remainder (modulo) without saying which sign the result takes. hashicorp/hcl computes a - b * trunc(a / b), so the result takes the sign of the dividend (Value.Modulo in cty/value_ops.go). For 7 % -3 truncated and Euclidean remainders give 1, while a floored remainder gives -2.
